Below is a concise “long‑weekend” calendar for Canada in 2023 based on the **federal statutory holidays** that apply nationwide.  
(If you’re targeting a specific province, let me know and I’ll add the provincial holidays that create extra long weekends.)

| # | Federal Holiday | Date 2023 | Day of Week | Observed On (if shifted) | Typical Long‑Weekend Window | Notes |
|---|-----------------|-----------|-------------|--------------------------|----------------------------|-------|
| 1 | New Year’s Day | Jan 1 | Sun | Mon Jan 2 | Dec 30 – Jan 2 | Shifted because it fell on a Sunday. |
| 2 | Family Day (AB, BC, MB, ON, SK) | Feb 20 | Mon | — | Feb 18 – Feb 20 | Only observed in those provinces. |
| 3 | Good Friday | Apr 7 | Fri | — | Apr 7 – Apr 9 | Creates a 3‑day weekend. |
| 4 | Victoria Day | May 22 | Mon | — | May 20 – May 22 | Creates a 3‑day weekend. |
| 5 | Canada Day | Jul 1 | Sat | Mon Jul 3 | Jul 1 – Jul 3 | Shifted because it fell on a Saturday. |
| 6 | Labour Day | Sep 4 | Mon | — | Sep 2 – Sep 4 | Creates a 3‑day weekend. |
| 7 | Thanksgiving | Oct 9 | Mon | — | Oct 7 – Oct 9 | Creates a 3‑day weekend. |
| 8 | Remembrance Day | Nov 11 | Fri | — | Nov 11 – Nov 13 | Creates a 3‑day weekend. |
| 9 | Christmas Day | Dec 25 | Mon | — | Dec 23 – Dec 25 | Creates a 3‑day weekend. |

### Quick Summary (by month)

| Month | Long‑Weekend Dates | Holiday | Province(s) (if applicable) |
|-------|--------------------|---------|-----------------------------|
| Jan | Dec 30 – Jan 2 | New Year’s Day | All |
| Feb | Feb 18 – Feb 20 | Family Day | AB, BC, MB, ON, SK |
| Apr | Apr 7 – Apr 9 | Good Friday | All |
| May | May 20 – May 22 | Victoria Day | All |
| Jul | Jul 1 – Jul 3 | Canada Day | All |
| Sep | Sep 2 – Sep 4 | Labour Day | All |
| Oct | Oct 7 – Oct 9 | Thanksgiving | All |
| Nov | Nov 11 – Nov 13 | Remembrance Day | All |
| Dec | Dec 23 – Dec 25 | Christmas Day | All |

> **Provinces with Extra Long‑Weekends (2023)**  
> • **Newfoundland & Labrador** – St. Patrick’s Day (Mar 17, Thu) → Mar 15 – Mar 17 (if employer grants a day off).  
> • **Quebec** – St. Jean Baptiste Day (Jun 24, Wed) → Jun 22 – Jun 24 (if employer grants a day off).  

---

#### How to Use This Data

* **CSV Format** (copy‑paste into your app’s import routine):

```

Canada Day,2023-07-01,Sat,2023-07-03,2023-07-01,2023-07-03,All
Labour Day,2023-09-04,Mon,,2023-09-02,2023-09-04,All
Thanksgiving,2023-10-09,Mon,,2023-10-07,2023-10-09,All
Remembrance Day,2023-11-11,Fri,,2023-11-11,2023-11-13,All
Christmas Day,2023-12-25,Mon,,2023-12-23,2023-12-25,All
```

* **JSON Format** (for API integration):

```json
[
  {
    "holiday": "New Year’s Day",
    "date": "2023-01-01",
```

Feel free to let me know if you’d like the data in another format (e.g., iCal, Excel, or a ready‑to‑import JSON file). If you’re targeting a specific province, I can generate a province‑specific long‑weekend list that includes all statutory holidays for that region.
